input.summary: Lumen Peptide Trading (V04, contact Jasper). Trader, not manufacturer; partner plants in China and Korea. Claims OTIF 97%, rejection 0.5%, but no delivery or rejection records shared (new to India); offers 2 Singapore references. Says suitable for cosmetics, ISO 9001 at manufacturer level, SDS to follow. Sent rate card photo and COA for Copper Tripeptide (RM-009). Open: RM-008 strength quoted on carnosic acid, spec is rosmarinic acid (20%); RM-009 COA shows 812 ppm vs quoted 1000 ppm. Outstanding knockouts: Q5 COA per line (batch, mfg, retest), Q9 SDS and Cosmetics Rules 2020 confirmation. Also Q6, Q8 (manufacturer/site, second source, records). Drafting consolidated request; no award or volume promised.

input.subject: KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on RM-008, RM-009 and quote documents
input.body:
Dear Jasper,

Thank you for your reply, the rate card and the COA for Copper Tripeptide-1. We need the following before we can evaluate your quote.

RM-008 Rosemary leaf extract
1. Our specification is 20% rosmarinic acid. Your strength is stated on carnosic acid, which cannot be compared with our spec. Please confirm the active content as rosmarinic acid (%) and provide the COA showing that value.

RM-009 Copper Tripeptide-1 solution
2. The COA shows 812 ppm peptide, but the quote states 1,000 ppm. Please confirm which value applies to the lot you will supply and explain the difference.

Mandatory documents (all lines you quote)
3. Certificate of Analysis from a recent batch for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.
4. Safety Data Sheet for each material, and written confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Quality and supply
5. Your rejection rate over the last 12 months, and the certifications you hold (including ISO 9001) with expiry dates.
6. Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site for each line, any second source, and state whether you will share delivery and rejection records for the OTIF and rejection figures you quoted.

Please reply with items 1 to 6. Items 3 and 4 are required before we can progress your quote.

Procurement Manager, Coimbatore plant
Kesavi Personal Care
